questions.question: In which of the following years, the Nawab of Awadh accepted the subsidiary alliance initiated by Lord Wellesley, the Governor General of British India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1801**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **In 1801, the Nawab of Awadh, Saadat Ali Khan II,** entered into the **Subsidiary Alliance** with the British.
 
• This alliance was devised as a political and military strategy by** Lord Wellesley, **the **Governor-General of British India, in 1798**.
 
• The terms of the Subsidiary Alliance included several stipulations:
 
 
• The Nawab was required to cede nearly half of his kingdom to the British, encompassing territories such as Rohilkhand and the region between the Ganga and the Jamuna rivers.
 
• The Nawab had to disband his own troops and rely instead on a British-managed army.
 
• The Nawab was obligated to pay substantial subsidies, often amounting to several lakhs of rupees.
 
• Article IV of the treaty affirmed that the forces provided by the British East India Company were deemed adequate to safeguard the ruler of Awadh.
 
• These terms effectively diminished the autonomy of the Nawab and established British dominance in Awadh.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Richard Colley Wellesley,** 1st Marquess Wellesley, was an Anglo-Irish politician and colonial administrator.
 
• He initially held the title of Viscount Wellesley until 1781 when he inherited his father's title as the 2nd Earl of Mornington.
 
• Later, in 1799, he was bestowed with the Irish peerage title of Marquess Wellesley. Additionally, he held the title of Lord Wellesley in the Peerage of Great Britain.

questions.question: When were the general elections to the Legislative Assembly of the National Capital Region held for the first time?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**In 1993**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** First Legislative Assembly of Delhi** was established in** November 1993**, following the replacement of the** Council of Ministers **with the **Delhi Legislative Assembly **through the **Constitution Act of 1991** and the **Government of National Capital Territory of Delhi Act, 1991,** which was facilitated by the Sixty-ninth Amendment to the Indian Constitution.
 
• This amendment officially designated the Union Territory of Delhi as the National Capital Territory of Delhi, subsequently enabling Delhi to conduct its first state elections.

questions.question: How is the molecular weight of a fatty acid determined?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Saponification value**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The saponification value** denotes the quantity of milligrams of **potassium hydroxide (KOH) or sodium hydroxide (NaOH)** needed to saponify one gram of fat, given specific conditions.
 
• This value serves as a gauge of the average molecular weight, or chain length, of the fatty acids contained within the sample in the form of triglycerides.
 
• In essence, a higher saponification value indicates a lower average length of fatty acids and a lighter mean molecular weight of triglycerides, while a lower value suggests the opposite.
 
• In practical terms, fats or oils possessing a high saponification value, such as coconut and palm oil, are more favorable for soap making.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The peroxide value (PV)** of an edible oil quantifies the degree of primary oxidation of unsaturated fats within the oil, primarily through the conversion of molecular oxygen into hydroperoxides and peroxides.
 
• **The acid value (AV)** is a numerical representation of the acidity level of a chemical substance, typically expressed in terms of the quantity of potassium hydroxide (KOH) required to neutralize the free acids present in one gram of the substance.
 
• **The iodine value (IV)** measures the mass of iodine in grams consumed by 100 grams of a chemical substance. It serves as an indicator of the degree of unsaturation or the number of double bonds present in the fatty acids comprising the substance, with higher values indicating greater unsaturation.

questions.question: A and B can complete a work in 16 days and 12 days respectively. Both work for 4 days and then A leaves. Find how much time will B take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 16 days.

B can complete the work in 12 days.

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/16

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/12

Together, in 1 day, they do = 1/16 + 1/12 = 3/48 + 4/48 = 7/48 of the work.

In 4 days, A and B together do = 4 × 7/48 = 28/48 = 7/12 of the work.

Work left after 4 days = 1 - 7/12 = 5/12

B's rate is 1/12 of the work per day.

Time for B to complete the remaining work = (Work left) / (B's rate per day)

⇒ (5/12) / (1/12) = 5 days

**B will take 5 more days to complete the remaining work.**

questions.question: On dividing 4⁹⁹⁹ to 7 what will the remainder be?

By Fermat's Little Theorem, ap−¹ leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by a prime p.

Remainder = 1¹⁶⁶ × 64 = 64. When 64 is divided by 7, the remainder is 1.

Expression: 4⁹⁹⁹ ÷ 7

Binomial Expansion Remainder Theorem

⇒ Expression: (63 + 1)³³³ ÷ 7

⇒ Using remainder theorem, (ax + k)ⁿ ÷ a leaves remainder kⁿ.

⇒ Remainder = 1³³³ = 1.

When (ax + k)ⁿ is divided by a, the remainder is always kⁿ. Similarly, (ax − 1)ⁿ divided by a leaves remainder 1 if n is even, and a−1 if n is odd.

Fermat's Little Theorem

If p is a prime number and a is not divisible by p, then ap−¹ leaves a remainder of 1 when divided by p. This provides an alternative fast method for remainder questions.
